# edit_general_topic()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.edit_general_topic`

## Signature

```python
async def edit_general_topic(chat_id: Union[int, str], title: str) -> bool: ...
```

## Documentation

Edit a general forum topic.

**Available to:** User accounts and bots.

### Parameters

- **`chat_id`** (`int` | `str`)
  Unique identifier (int) or username (str) of the target chat.
  You can also use chat public link in form of *t.me/<username>* (str).

- **`title`** (`str`)
  The general forum topic title.

### Returns

`bool`: On success, a True is returned.

### Example

```python
await app.edit_general_topic(chat_id,"New Topic Title")
```
